title: The Ashcombe Dome
tagline: A dead astronomer in a dome bolted from the inside. The door log agrees. Should it?
hook: The director of a hilltop observatory is found at the foot of a ladder in a telescope dome that the caretaker had to force open. The file says he fell in the dark. The pathologist is not so sure, and the door log is a little too tidy. This is an Expert file: not every document in it is honest, and the truth may need more than one name.
note: Expert. Two people are responsible, and one document is forged.
advice: Before you spend, ask what in the file made you want it, and whether you already hold the answer. Clearing a person you have already cleared is a luxury.

phases.prompt: Accident or not? Write down what in B-1 does not fit a fall.

phases.prompt: When was he last alive, and who could have been in the dome? Is every record here complete?

rules: The documents don't lie. People might. So might a printout: ask who supplied each record, and whether it is complete.
The whole file is yours, in three phases. The tension is in what you spend, not what you hide.
You have a fixed number of Authorities and they do not come back. Several return nothing you need.
Write your working on the Resolution Sheet as you establish it, with document references. Anything not written before the final accusation scores nothing.
You get two wrong accusations. Each costs 10 points and opens a Reconsider envelope naming the gap in your theory. The third accusation is final.
When you are done, break the seal on Envelope S-1 and read it in order.

steps: Count the head injuries in B-1, and note where on the skull each one is.
Injury 2 has a pattern. E-1.3 says what the ladder's surfaces look like.
E-1.2: one counterweight has a 34 mm knurled grip, and it is the only clean one. Authority 03 or 09 confirms it.
Ask who said the door was bolted, and who forced it. Then read E-1.1 about the damage.
The splinters and the pry marks are on the inside. A door forced from the corridor is damaged on the outside.
Authority 01 shows what the door did at 07:08 when Brackley's code opened it.
One record was printed for the police by a person in this file. Which one, and by whom?
The lock numbers every event in order. Read D-1's sequence column, then its footer.
D-1 jumps from #4471 to #4478 and shows five events of eleven. Authority 01 is the full record.
D-2 tells you when Hale was last alive and when the imaging finished. Compare that with C-2.
Lindqvist says he watched every frame until about two. The sequence finished at 01:20.
Authorities 01 and 02 together put him in the dome from 01:24 to 01:52.

hints.q: Why would anyone help cover it up?
steps: Brackley told the police nobody rang him that night. Can you check?
Authority 04: his telephone and his bank account.
A call from Lindqvist at 03:18, and $4,000 from Lindqvist at 06:41, before the body was 'found'.
